t: 99% Tenacity: A Debugging Odyssey with an AI Collaborator
s: This article details a multi-layered debugging journey in modern software development, where an AI acts as a key collaborator. It highlights the non-linear process of building tools, focusing on achieving persistent 'Hello World' in a Jupyter Notebook using the Pipulate library to manage state externally, mimicking Unix pipes for resilience.
sub: Jupyter Notebook state management and persistence
Pipulate library for externalizing notebook state
Conceptual parallels between Jupyter Notebooks and Unix pipes
